title: Operation "Zero Zeno": Israel-linked influence activity
summary: OpenAI banned accounts linked to a previously unreprorted Israel-origin operation we dubbed “Zero Zeno,” using AI to generate anti-Hamas, anti-Qatar, pro-Israel, anti-BJP, and pro-Histadrut content.
body: OpenAI banned accounts linked to a previously unreprorted Israel-origin operation we dubbed “Zero Zeno,” using AI to generate anti-Hamas, anti-Qatar, pro-Israel, anti-BJP, and pro-Histadrut content.
summaryZh: OpenAI封禁了与以色列关联的“Zero Zeno”网络账户。该组织利用AI生成大量针对特定政治议题的虚假内容，试图进行舆论干预。OpenAI通过此类行动展示了其在监控和打击滥用AI进行恶意影响方面的治理能力。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI封禁了利用AI进行虚假信息传播的以色列关联网络，体现了模型安全治理的持续行动。
